text: Lisbon is the capital and largest city of Portugal, situated on the Atlantic coast where the Tagus River meets the ocean. It is one of the oldest cities in Western Europe, predating other modern capitals such as London and Paris by centuries. The city is built across seven hills, which makes many of its streets steep and winding. Lisbon has a mild Mediterranean climate, with warm dry summers and cool rainy winters. Its historic tram network, especially the yellow Route 28 tram, is a well known feature. The 1755 Lisbon earthquake destroyed much of the city and led to a major rebuilding of the downtown Baixa district in a grid pattern.
